identity.name: Seeds  Idea Incubator
identity.description: Seeds honeycomb  entry point for all raw ideas, Scout Agent findings, and unprocessed concepts. Seeds mature into Tasks or Roadmaps.

meta.description: Seeds is the entry point for all raw ideas, external findings, and unprocessed concepts. Seeds are evaluated and either become Tasks (1 month) or Roadmaps (>1 month).
meta.lifecycle: Seeds are created by Gardener, External SR, or Scout Agent. Upon evaluation, they are transformed into Tasks or Roadmaps and moved from seeds/ to the corresponding honeycomb.

rules.creation: Any SR or Gardener can create a seed. Format must follow basic_seed.json template.
rules.evaluation: Seeds are reviewed by Gardener. Decision: promote to Task, promote to Roadmap, or archive.
rules.archiving: Processed seeds are moved to seeds/archive/.

health.notes: Translated to English (v3.0.0 core). Clean UTF-8.
